find: if (active !== panelArrival.target && active !== document.body && active !== null) return;
why: A browser drops focus to <body> from a control that is hidden under it, and the Main Menu's arrival hides Continue when the run turns out to be over (issue #919). The follow must treat a dropped focus as unmoved and put it on the control the arrival would pick now, or a keyboard or pad player is left with no position on the menu.
killedBy: hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) the Main Menu arrival follow picks up a focus the browser dropped to <body>
